target_questions.question: Does the review supply terminology and secondary context for injection timing, pressure, interval, injector design, and fuel composition?
target_questions.target_basis: Tier 1 A030 is the hydrogen-diesel review anchor; this natural-gas review supplies parallel HPDI context without primary-data promotion.

evidence_candidates.claim_text: The review organizes pilot-ignited HPDI natural-gas performance around injection timing, pressure, pilot-to-gas interval, injector design, load range, and gas composition.
evidence_candidates.evidence_summary: A secondary synthesis maps the principal controllable factors and their reported combustion/emission tradeoffs.

limitations: Secondary evidence only; heterogeneous cited definitions and conditions must be checked against primary papers before quantitative use.
visual_verification: Targeted visual verification performed where numeric/glyph-dependent abstract claims required it; no figure digitization.
